verdict.rationale: Vercel's Fluid compute is described as running server-side code 'on demand' and scaling concurrency for AI/I/O-heavy workloads, which hints at active-compute-based billing rather than idle wall-clock billing, but no evidence explicitly states the pricing/billing model or contrasts it with traditional serverless idle-time billing. missing for 10: explicit pricing docs confirming billing only for active compute time, comparison to idle wall-clock billing, and independent/third-party confirmation of actual billing behavior.
